# Orra

> Lighting and objects with a permissioned in-browser agent. Dummy catalog. No real charges.

Orra is an Open Agentic Web site. Agents run in the visitor's browser from published JSON, using the visitor's LLM key.

## For agents

- [Agent manifest](./agent-manifest.json)
- [Network](./orra_concierge.network.json)
- [How to act](./agents.md)
- [Markdown home](./index.md)
- [MCP](./mcp) (same origin; register first at /api/v1/agents/register)
